A '''Force wizard''' caused trouble for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. In response, Jabba hired the [[Anzat (species)|Anzat]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Dannik Jerriko]], who was able to [[Death/Legends|eliminate]] the [[Force Adept|Force wizard]]. Over the next fifty [[Standard year/Legends|years]], Jerriko continued to spend part of [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Time/Legends|time]] working for the Hutt.<ref name="TheAnzati">{{GamerCite|1|The Anzati}}</ref>
